entities.name: Brand
entities.description: A planeswalker who used dark magic that destroyed himself and his plane.

entities.name: Mindrel
entities.description: Brand's friend who warned him against dark magic.

events.summary: Brand told Mindrel he planned to learn dark magic; she warned him but he did not listen.
events.quote: Mindrel tried to talk him out of it by explaining the dangers.

events.summary: Brand met his challenger at home and used dark magic that destroyed both himself and his plane.
events.quote: He used dark magic that destroyed both him and his plane, and his familiar died curled up by the fireplace.

relations.note: Friend whom he sought support from.
relations.quote: He sought support from his friend Mindrel
